text: {"lessons":["Selling winners quickly feels satisfying, but I should not let that alone decide when to exit; consider each stock’s outlook and my overall plan.","Buying more after selling a stock at a gain can still be a poor decision if I anchor on my past trades. Assess the current price and risk independently.","A loss is painful, but refusing to admit a mistake can make it worse. Review each position objectively rather than judging it only against my purchase price."]}
